key_decisions.decision: Retains pinned now in the difficult numerical clause rather than silently changing it to you; the familiar alternative requires a note.
Retains the public nature of the order, essential to the later refusal.
Follows read spread and preserves the devouring forest without inventing mechanisms of death.
Retains head rather than substituting hair and preserves heaven-earth suspension.
Follows read even if and unfolds the difficult warning without changing its protective force.

Keeps three weapons, continued life, and repeated heart image.
Retains the distinct final killing by ten attendants.
Retains the no-son statement without inventing a reconciliation with 14:27.
Retains the repeated today and reason for refusing him.
